title: Swipes stay responsive between screens
summary: A new swipe can start immediately while the previous page is still settling, so rapid navigation no longer drops touches.
changes: If another gesture begins during the short page-settle animation, the pending destination is completed immediately and the new gesture starts normally instead of being ignored.
Rapid navigation between Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat therefore remains responsive even when gestures follow each other closely.
Continuous bottom-bar dragging, direction locking, protected message and form controls, and the more stable bottom chrome remain in place.
Roster calculations, Supabase data, authentication and the safe PWA update flow are unchanged.
